notes.title: Inferno - 2025/01/29 Update
notes.content:
[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]
[list][*]NEW FEATURE backported from [i]Part III: Paradiso[/i]: Test clips in the Character Voice Settings menu are now subtitled. Your favorite characters might have some interesting things to say...?! This menu is accessible through the Individual Character Voice Settings button located in the lower left-hand corner of the main Config menu.
[*]Fixes several typos in the Chinese versions of the game.[/list]
Save BIG on [i]The Shell[/i] in our Lunar New Year sale until this weekend!
